name: OpenThread Border Router
short_desc: Thread mesh network border router (network RCP)
author: OpenThread
description: OpenThread Border Router (OTBR) connects a Thread mesh network to other IP-based networks such as your LAN and the internet. It is required to bring Thread-based smart-home devices (Matter-over-Thread) onto your network. This build uses the bnutzer/otbr-tcp image, which bridges a network-attached (serial-over-IP) 802.15.4 Radio Co-Processor — e.g. an SLZB-06/-MR — to OTBR via socat. No USB dongle or host serial device is needed; point it at the radio's IP and TCP port.

form_fields.label: RCP radio host
form_fields.hint: IP or hostname of your network-attached Thread radio (e.g. SLZB-06M).

form_fields.label: RCP radio TCP port
form_fields.hint: Serial-over-IP TCP port of the Thread radio. SLZB default is 6638.

form_fields.label: RCP baudrate
form_fields.hint: RCP UART baudrate. Leave at 460800 unless your radio differs.

form_fields.label: Backbone interface
form_fields.hint: Host LAN/Wi-Fi interface, e.g. eth0 or wlan0.
